nodes.text: Build me a compact, sunlit New York City brownstone block centered on two narrow asphalt streets meeting at a right-angle intersection. Line concrete curbs and sidewalks with roughly fifteen tightly spaced three- to five-story row houses and small apartment buildings, creating a nearly continuous street wall with slight variations in height and setback. Use predominantly weathered red brick, with occasional brownstone and pale stone façades, dark-painted trim, flat parapet roofs, and a few mansard or stepped-gable profiles. Detail the buildings with repetitive sash windows, shutters, projecting bays, cornices, window air conditioners, fire escapes, basement openings, and raised stoops enclosed by ornate black iron railings. Add mature leafy street trees in guards, small planted front areas, benches, and American flags. Mark the roads with crosswalks, dashed lane lines, manholes, and scattered fallen leaves. Include curved streetlamps, blue mailboxes, hydrants, refuse bins, street signs, a yellow taxi, a van, and a dark sedan. Use bright midday sunlight, strong tree shadows, and light atmospheric haze.

clauses.text: Build me a compact, sunlit New York City brownstone block centered on two narrow asphalt streets meeting at a right-angle intersection

Line concrete curbs and sidewalks with roughly fifteen tightly spaced three- to five-story row houses and small apartment buildings, creating a nearly continuous street wall with slight variations in height and setback
Use predominantly weathered red brick, with occasional brownstone and pale stone façades, dark-painted trim, flat parapet roofs, and a few mansard or stepped-gable profiles

Detail the buildings with repetitive sash windows, shutters, projecting bays, cornices, window air conditioners, fire escapes, basement openings, and raised stoops enclosed by ornate black iron railings
Add mature leafy street trees in guards, small planted front areas, benches, and American flags
Mark the roads with crosswalks, dashed lane lines, manholes, and scattered fallen leaves
Include curved streetlamps, blue mailboxes, hydrants, refuse bins, street signs, a yellow taxi, a van, and a dark sedan
Use bright midday sunlight, strong tree shadows, and light atmospheric haze
